diagnostic_only_statement: This diagnostic sensitivity artifact does not supersede or amend the sealed P0 no-go and performs no tier selection.

reference_curve_definitions.min_marginal_bound: weighted mean over surviving non-rho prior cells of the minimum per-component marginal power

rho_zero_closed_form_validation.method: rho=0 joint Monte Carlo estimate versus product of component marginal estimates; conservative delta-method error with 99% Bonferroni familywise coverage
